subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: What durable shape should replace inline per-session `systemPromptReport` storage while preserving bootstrap warning dedupe and session compatibility?
rationale: Current source intentionally keeps warning-dedupe state in the report, while field data shows the full report is now the dominant duplicated session-store payload.

options.title: Persist minimal report state
options.body: Store only compact warning-dedupe/runtime metadata in session rows and make bulky tools, skills, and injected-file report sections recomputable or diagnostic-only.

options.title: Out-of-line report blobs
options.body: Move full prompt reports to content-addressed or session-scoped storage and keep compact refs in `sessions.json`.

options.title: Retain inline reports
options.body: Keep the current row shape and rely on entry retention/capping while accepting duplicated prompt-report payloads in retained sessions.

recommendation.title: Persist minimal report state
recommendation.body: Store only compact warning-dedupe/runtime metadata in session rows and make bulky tools, skills, and injected-file report sections recomputable or diagnostic-only.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle introduced prompt-report metadata and later authored the adjacent prompt-blob storage mitigation.
